segments.name: Annuity
segments.description: Develops, markets and administers annuity products offering tax-deferred retirement savings and income.
segments.evidence: Annuity products include fixed indexed annuity, traditional fixed rate annuity and single premium immediate annuity products.

segments.name: Fee income
segments.description: Provides benefits education, advocacy and communications services through Optavise and third-party fee arrangements.
segments.evidence: Optavise, LLC provides personalized benefits education, advocacy and transparency, and communications services that help employers reduce healthcare costs and assist employees with making informed benefits decisions.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay premiums for insurance products and fees for benefits education and administration services; company earns investment income on assets.
revenueModel.evidence: We had premium collections of $4.6 billion, $4.4 billion and $4.1 billion in 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively.

changes.text: In 2025, announced intention to exit the fee services business within Worksite Division, with exit expected substantially completed in first half of 2026.
changes.evidence: In November 2025, we announced our intention to exit the fee services business within our Worksite Division to sharpen our focus on the core insurance business.
